findings.description: Every residue can hold while a player who dies never comes back: the play probe runs in god mode, so the checkpoints and the mod's respawn are never exercised in 06's layered geometry (a cap, the deck, the tower).

residue.description: A player killed on the deck comes back within 8 s at the last checkpoint reached, standing on a floor.
residue.rationale: Checkpoints are the co-op and solo safety net.

findings.description: boat-run only proves the boat goes east; 'vehicles fit and can leave' also needs it to back out of the lane's end and return west.

residue.description: After its run east the players' boat drives back west at least 1500 px under the caps.
residue.rationale: Checklist: vehicles fit and can leave.

findings.description: The command room is only reached through the tower's own ladder shaft, but the objective test teleports into it; the tower climb itself is never played.

residue.description: From the tower lobby a player climbs the tower's shaft to the command room floor and on to the observation deck.
residue.rationale: The centre objective must be reachable in play, not only on paper.

findings.description: look-dusk-palette measures colour only: an image of mostly sky-coloured emptiness could pass it. The structure (bands top to bottom, where the detail is) must match too.

residue.description: The pulled-back view of the middle has the concept's structure: brightness profile top to bottom within 30 levels on average, and edge detail spread over the frame like the concept's (detail-grid distance at most 0.06).
residue.rationale: Closes a way to game the look residue.

findings.description: The emergent property 'each foundation reads as a distinct fight with cover, height and a flank' has no residue: the caps as first built are flat slabs.

residue.description: Every pier cap carries cover to fight from (at least one block 40-110 px tall standing on it) besides its ladders and neighbouring containers.

findings.description: coop-two can pass while guests can't use the ladders (the ladder code moves characters on the host from their controllers' inputs; a guest's input path differs from the host's keyboard).

residue.description: In a two-player match a guest climbs a pier cap's ladder out of the water onto the cap.
residue.rationale: Co-op players need the ladders as much as the host.

findings.description: Editor saveability: the level is built only from the editor's own templates plus registered mod entities, which the linter parses; no separate residue needed.
The hanging-container jump chain is an optional route; the linter proves the jumps are within the rules. Not material.
